name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Our complete customer satisfaction is our number one goal.  Don and Daria Novak scour the world bringing you name brand quality household and office products at bargain prices!



Don Novak was born in Seattle, Washington and graduated from UCLA. A former Army Ranger, Vietnam Vet, Hollywood actor and stuntman, retail chain store owner in Hawaii and retired Florida Real Estate Broker. Daria Novak was born and raised in Anderson, Indiana, worked at GM and Delphi. Also spent the last 30 years as an interior decorator and antique collector. Daria is the proud grandmother of 7.
